Lead the formulation, development, and optimization of new programs, designs, and prototypes.
Participate in research formulating and writing with other staff.
Assess new technologies and future applications of technologies.
Propose, plan, and manage research projects, report preparation, and presentation of findings.
Apply for grants to continue their research.
May be required to mentor, train and/or coach junior research scientists.
Stay up to date on developments within their field through methods such as reading academic journals, attending training programs and attending conferences within their field.

Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in a scientific discipline required; advanced degree strongly preferred. MS with a minimum of 2 years of demonstrated expertise, or BS with a minimum of 4 years of substantial hands-on experience.
Advanced knowledge of Chemistry, Material Science, Chemical Engineering, or Process Engineering.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a proven track record of producing clear technical reports and effectively conveying findings to internal stakeholders.
Preferred Requirements
Deep expertise in formulation and process development with hydrogels and contact lens care products.
